# coval_personas (Data Source)

Lists Coval simulated personas visible to the configured API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "coval_personas" "support" {
  filter      = "name=\"Friendly Support Customer\""
  order_by    = "-create_time"
  tag_filters = ["support", "voice"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Optional public API filter expression. Quote string values containing spaces.
- `order_by` (String) Optional ordering expression using create_time, update_time, or name.
- `tag_filters` (Set of String) Optional tags that every returned persona must have.
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID that scopes this lookup. Omit it to use the organization's active default workspace.

### Read-Only

- `personas` (Attributes List) All matching personas. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--personas))

<a id="nestedatt--personas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `personas`

Read-Only:

- `audio_degradation` (Attributes) Channel degradation preset applied to the persona. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--personas--audio_degradation))
- `background_sound` (String) Background sound ID.
- `background_sound_volume` (Number) Background-sound volume.
- `conversation_initiation` (String) Who initiates the conversation.
- `create_time` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `custom_persona_data` (String) Serialized JSON object sent as custom persona data for compatible chat agents.
- `custom_voice_id` (String) Server-issued custom voice reference.
- `hold_music_timeout_seconds` (Number) Seconds of no speech before disconnecting a hold-music scenario.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned persona ID.
- `interruption_rate` (String) How often the persona interrupts the agent.
- `language_code` (String) BCP-47 language code for voice synthesis.
- `multi_language_stt` (Boolean) Whether multilingual speech-to-text is enabled.
- `multi_phone_config` (Attributes) Caller-number selection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--personas--multi_phone_config))
- `name` (String) Human-readable persona name.
- `persona_prompt` (String) Instructions describing the persona's behavior and personality.
- `resource_name` (String) Canonical API resource name.
- `silent_mode` (Boolean) Whether the persona remains silent for the entire simulation.
- `situate_speaker` (String) Persona speaker-placement preset.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags associated with the persona.
- `update_time` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the latest update.
- `voice` (String) Agent voice override for OpenAI Realtime endpoint simulations.
- `voice_name` (String) Coval voice name.
- `voice_speed` (Number) Voice-speed multiplier.
- `voice_volume` (Number) Voice gain multiplier.
- `wait_seconds` (Number) Response delay in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--personas--audio_degradation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `personas.audio_degradation`

Read-Only:

- `preset` (String) Channel degradation preset.
- `preset_version` (Number) Version of the channel degradation preset.


<a id="nestedatt--personas--multi_phone_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `personas.multi_phone_config`

Read-Only:

- `phone_number_name` (String) Display name for the selected caller number.
